messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

message.reasoning: The user asks: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" which translates to "How frequently did members of the Modern Art Museum visit last year?" They want the frequency of visits by members of the Modern Art Museum last year. We need to retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. But the question is about frequency of visits by members. We might interpret as: find the most frequent visitor among members? Or maybe we need to compute average visits per member? The function most_frequent_visitor returns the visitor who visited the museum the most within a period. But the question is about "會員們有多頻繁地參觀" meaning "how frequently did members visit". That could be interpreted as average visits per member or the most frequent visitor among members. The function doesn't filter by membership status. It just returns the most frequent visitor. But we can call it for the period of last year. The museum name is "現代藝術博物館" (Modern Art Museum). The period: last year. If current year is 2026, last year is 2025. So start_date: 2025-01-01, end_date: 2025-12-31. Minimum_visits default 1. So we call the function.
